Corporate and Institutional Banking

HSBC Corporate and Institutional Banking is a markets-led, financing-focused business that provides investment and financial solutions. Through our international network, we connect emerging and mature markets, covering key growth areas. We partner with our corporate, government and institutional clients to help them achieve consistent, long-term performance. Our products and services include advisory, financing, prime services, research and analysis, securities services, trading and sales and transaction banking.

We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team.

In This Role, You Will

  • Responsible for the delivery of Business Credit Office (BCO) tasks in line with agreed OKRs, SLAs and KPIs
  • Responsible for coordinating between stakeholders to ensure completion of tasks e.g. (but not limited to) credit monitoring and credit maintenance, documents review & submission, limit loading & drawdown
  • Engagement with customers where required
  • Manage the timely updates to bank systems and records for e.g. covenant
  • Support the BCO Manager, Analyst and Team Leads on the management of the end-to-end customer credit & capital management journey ensuring a seamless and efficient process for both customers and internal stakeholders
  • Support the execution of business initiatives and drive continuous improvement, ensuring fair customer treatment and delivery of customer satisfaction
  • Actively participate in training sessions to continue to develop credit skills, product knowledge, industry knowledge and client management skills.
  • Ensure the consistent application of HSBC policies and adherence to regulatory, financial, and legal standards to minimize business and reputational risks
  • Manage regulatory and reputational risk within own responsibility and ensure adherence to regulatory risk frameworks and adherence to all published policies & procedures

To be successful in the role, you should meet the following requirements:

  • Bachelor’s degree in business, Finance, or a related field will be preferred
  • Corporate lending experience with strong analytical skills and sound credit knowledge
  • Strong stakeholder management skills, with the ability to navigate complex situations and drive alignment among senior leaders
  • Clear understanding of the Group credit risk principles, policies and statutory compliances
  • Strong commercial mindset
  • Strong communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to influence and collaborate effectively across all levels of the organization

You’ll achieve more at HSBC.

HSBC is committed to building a culture where all employees are valued, respected and opinions count. We take pride in providing a workplace that fosters continuous professional development, flexible working and opportunities to grow within and inclusive and diverse environment. Personal data held by the Bank relating to employment applications will be used in accordance with our Privacy Statement, which is available on our website.

Location: Guangzhou / Xi'an / Shenzhen

Job ID: 45919

Principal Responsibilities

  • GenAI Agent platform engineering: design and develop the agent runtime, orchestration, tool/function calling, prompt and workflow management, memory/state handling, and integration patterns—leveraging frameworks such as LangChain/LangGraph (where appropriate) while avoiding unnecessary vendor/framework lock-in.
  • Continuously monitor and optimise platform performance in production, including model selection, prompt/agent tuning, retrieval quality, caching, throughput, and resilience; drive root-cause analysis and preventative improvements.
  • Embed security, privacy and compliance by design & development: ensure controls for data handling, access management, encryption, auditability, model risk considerations, and safe tool use; align to internal governance and relevant regulatory expectations.
  • Maintain platform documentation and enablement: publish reference design, APIs/SDKs, templates, testing, and developer guidance to accelerate adoption and consistent delivery across teams.
  • Track and evaluate emerging GenAI/agent capabilities (e.g., new orchestration patterns, evaluation methods, safety techniques, model/tooling advances) and translate them into pragmatic platform enhancements with clear value, risk and cost trade-offs.

Requirements

  • Education & English: Bachelor’s degree or above in Computer Science/Engineering (or related);
  • Software Engineering: 2+ years’ handon coding practice, strong Python or Java or Golang, with usage of at least one major cloud (AWS/Azure/GCP); ability to deploy and operate services in production (Docker/Kubernetes preferred).
  • Demonstrates an AI-native mindset by applying AI-driven approaches, including coding assistants, to improve productivity, quality, and engineering best practices
  • GenAI / LLM Delivery: knowledge with any one in GenAI, LLMs, MCP, RAG agentic workflows, tool/function calling will be a plus

The Sec & Derivatives Sr Analyst is an intermediate level position responsible for processing orders and transactions originating from trading desks and branch offices in coordination with the Operations - Transaction Services team. The overall objective of this role is to facilitate the clearance, settlement and investigation of client securities and derivatives transactions.

Responsibilities:

  • Resolve complex process problems which require an in-depth evaluation of basic securities processing procedures and industry standards
  • Process various hedge fund tasks, including calculating net asset value, reconciling cash and holdings, and pricing securities
  • Offer advanced solutions for assigned securities processing areas
  • Provide guidance and assistance to junior staff
  • Oversee the set-up of new hedge funds, while representing a securities processing team, and acting as the analytical and procedural expert
  • Serve as analytical or procedural expert for securities processing deliverables/initiatives
  • Prepare expense budgets, analyze expense calculations, and prepare unaudited financial statements
  • Ascertain fund value and allocate values to each investor
  • Assist with the development of new techniques and streamlining hedge fund/securities processing activities
  • Appropriately assess risk when business decisions are made, demonstrating particular consideration for the firm's reputation and safeguarding Citigroup, its clients and assets, by driving compliance with applicable laws, rules and regulations, adhering to Policy, applying sound ethical judgment regarding personal behavior, conduct and business practices, and escalating, managing and reporting control issues with transparency.

Recommended Qualifications:

  • 5-8 years of relevant experience
  • Consistently demonstrates clear and concise written and verbal communication skills

Education:

  • Bachelor’s Degree/University degree or equivalent experience

Within International Wealth and Premier Banking (IWPB), we serve 41 million customers globally, including 6.7 million who are international, from retail customers to ultra high net worth individuals and their families. We help our customers to take care of their day-to-day finances and to manage, protect and grow their wealth. Our international network and breadth of expertise enable us to deliver on HSBC’s purpose of opening up a world of opportunity by providing our customers with borderless banking and world-class wealth management through best-in-class, mobile-first capabilities and exceptional people. Our key areas of operations include Retail Banking and Wealth Management, Asset Management, Global Private Banking and Insurance.

We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team.

In This Role, You Will

  • Conduct product training to support and deliver new product launches and lead client education events to help clients gain better knowledge of financial markets and financial solutions.
  • Follow the needs-based sales process, give clients meaningful and consistent wealth experience and ultimately provide an outstanding client experience
  • Support RMs to gain more client trust and commitment in broadening and deepening their relationship with HSBC, and increase the effectiveness and quality of needs fulfilled for target clients
  • Strengthen HSBC’s image as a leading wealth provider by providing clients with access to advanced technical product expertise

  • Deep knowledge of specific complex financial solutions and products including the knowledge of financial markets, social-economic dynamics, and regulatory requirement relevant to the products
  • Extensive external market awareness of market conditions, new product solutions, and an understanding of current financial market activities
  • Demonstrated ability and experience to correctly identify client needs

  • A solid understanding of global Anti-money Laundering standards

  • Knowledge of local and Group compliance regulation

  • 能够深度挖掘客户需求
  • 熟悉销售流程

Job Summary

  • Oversee end-to-end banking regulatory reporting process including data collection and organization, understanding regulatory requirements, completing and submitting SCB China and branches regulatory reports. Ensure accurate, complete and on-time submission of all regulatory returns.
  • Support to identify and mitigate potential regulatory risks related to reporting errors, delays, or non-compliance, and implement corrective actions as needed.
  • Support to act as the key liaison with external regulators, providing updates, responding to queries, and representing the company in regulatory discussions and inspections.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams, work closely with legal, finance, risk, and IT departments to ensure consistency and completeness of data used in regulatory submissions and to address any compliance-related issues.
  • Support to evaluate and improve the effectiveness of reporting systems and tools to enhance efficiency and reduce manual processes through automation

Key Responsibilities

  • Handle regulatory (NFRA, PBOC, SAFE, the Bureau of Finance, the Bureau of Statistics etc.) returns preparation and submission, ensures that all regulatory submissions are accurate, complete, and submitted on time, as well as regulatory reporting instruction changes interpretation and implementation.
  • Support line manager to maintain robust quality control procedures to ensure the accuracy, completeness, and timeliness of all regulatory submissions, and reporting issues escalated through agreed governance channels.
  • Support PPG and China CA review and system upgrade project including end to end accounting flow review, upgrade the reporting logic, UAT support, regulatory reporting impact analysis to ensure compliance, accuracy and completeness.
  • Maintain good relationships with relevant internal departments, assist the line manager in coordinating with the finance department and other internal functional departments for discussions, such as establishing reporting procedures for new reporting requirements, and promptly and properly resolving related regulatory reporting issues.
  • Manage regulatory and internal stakeholder requirements, including preparation of management information, responses to regulatory enquiries, audit support, remediation plans and evidence of sustainable control improvements.
  • Support line manager to drive process and system optimisation improvements in processes, reporting, data quality through reporting automation while improving the transparency, efficiency and resilience of the control environment.

Skills And Experience

Must-have Skills

  • Solid knowledge of banking accounting and regulatory reporting rules
  • Hands-on experience in end-to-end regulatory reporting process
  • Strong data analysis and problem-solving abilities

Other Skills

  • High attention to detail and strict regulatory risk awareness
  • Stakeholder Management
  • Analytical and Communication skills
  • Strong accountability and ability to work under high pressure

Motivations

  • Operating in a complex and evolving China regulatory environment, very stringent regulatory environment casts great pressure on regulatory reporting including tight local reporting deadline, continuous changing reporting requirements, energized by the fast-paced, deadline-driven nature of regulatory reporting, motivated by the challenge of meeting tight deadlines under pressure while maintaining accuracy and compliance.
  • Motivated by the opportunity to streamline regulatory reporting processes, reduce errors, and enhance efficiency, driven by outcomes such as improved reporting accuracy, more efficient reporting process, reduced compliance risks etc.
  • Performs best in environments that encourage collaboration, knowledge sharing, and professional growth, motivated by working with cross-functional teams build a strong, capable regulatory reporting function.
  • Continuous learning and adaptability required, motivated by the need to stay current with regulatory changes, emerging technologies, and industry best practices, enjoy learning and applying new automation tools and methodologies to improve reporting systems and outcomes.
  • Driven by a commitment to ethical standards and accountability, motivated by the responsibility to uphold the organization’s reputation and ensure compliance with applicable laws and regulations.

Qualifications

Key Experiences

  • Demonstrated ability to operate effectively across different regulatory, cultural and organisational environments, adapting o global frameworks and local requirements while preserving appropriate governance, control and consistency
  • Proven Experience dealing complex issues through ambiguity, bringing together multiple stakeholders, forming a clear view from incomplete conflicting information and driving decisions and remediation through to sustainable closure

Certifications/Qualifications

  • CICPA & ACCA is preferred

Languages

  • Chinese and English

About Standard Chartered

We're a global bank connecting clients to our differentiated network, offering growth opportunities in the world's most dynamic markets. Our strategy, which combines cross-border capabilities and leading wealth management expertise, helps us deliver our purpose - to drive commerce and prosperity through our unique diversity.

Over our 170-year history, and across a unique geographical footprint connecting Asia, Africa and the Middle East to each other and the world, we've built a bank like no other, with diverse capabilities and partnerships that set us apart.

What We Offer

  • Being part of an inclusive and values driven organisation, one that embraces and celebrates our unique diversity, across our teams, business functions, and geographies.
  • In line with our Fair Pay Charter, we offer a competitive salary and benefits to support your mental, physical, financial and social wellbeing.
  • Core bank funding for retirement savings, medical and life insurance, with flexible and voluntary benefits available in some locations.
  • Time-off including annual leave, parental/maternity (20 weeks), sabbatical (12 months maximum) and volunteering leave (3 days), along with minimum global standards for annual and public holiday, which is combined to 30 days minimum.
  • Flexible working options based around home and office locations, with flexible working patterns.
  • Proactive wellbeing support through Unmind, a market-leading digital wellbeing platform, development courses for resilience and other human skills, global employee assistance programme, sick leave, mental health first-aiders and self-help toolkits.
  • A continuous learning culture to support your growth, with opportunities to reskill and upskill and access to physical, virtual, and digital learning.

Visit our careers website to learn more about us: www.sc.com/careers.

The Sales Trader is a senior-level position responsible for assisting clients to execute trades, serving as an intermediary in trading for clients. The overall objective of this role is to ensure the seamless delivery of investment strategies and advisory services to our public and private clients.

Responsibilities

  • Market Citigroup’s execution capabilities, contribute to team strategy and deliver a high level of customer service
  • Develop new relationships, cement current relationships and share existing relationships with Citi colleagues
  • Cross sell into Swaps / ETFs / PB / Derivatives etc. and offer certain client full sales trading plus trading coverage
  • Ensure compliance with all relevant regulations and internal policy
  • Lead strong governance and controls
  • Work in close partnership with control functions such as Legal, Compliance, Market and Credit Risk, Audit, Finance in order to ensure appropriate governance and control infrastructure
  • Build a culture of responsible finance, good governance and supervision, expense discipline and ethics
  • Appropriately assess risk/reward of transactions when making business decisions; demonstrating proper consideration for the firm’s reputation
  • Be familiar with and adhere to Citi’s Code of Conduct and the Plan of Supervision for Global Markets and Securities Services

Business: GPS Technology

Job ID: 65692

Principal Responsibilities

  • Taking part in optimization of the AI Agent to improve performance, scalability, resilience and cost efficiency, enabling Generative and Agentic AI use cases across GPS.
  • Taking part in the evaluation and adoption of AI and ML technologies for GPS, with a focus on LLM, agentic AI, RAG, knowledge management, and emerging engineering patterns.
  • Embed AI-native capabilities into engineering workflows, such as AI coding, technical solution generation, test case generation, test report generation, and automated environment setup/orchestration.
  • Taking part in architecture design and core capability development for AI Agent Applications, including task orchestration, tool invocation, context management, memory mechanisms, and multi-agent collaboration.
  • Runtime governance & operational framework, Establish AI agent runtime and governance frameworks, including Isolation and sandboxing, access control and permission, Auditability and traceability Evaluation and quality measurement.
  • Knowledge augmentation layer design: integrate, and apply enterprise knowledge enhancement capabilities, including RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation), GraphRAG, Knowledge graphs (design, integration, and application)
  • Partner across business lines and infrastructure team to align priorities, integrate requirements and unblock delivery across regions and time zones

Knowledge & Experience/Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in computer science, Software Engineering, or a related discipline.
  • 8+ of experience delivering enterprise software/platform solutions including 3+ years in senior engineering leadership roles, especially 2+ years in Agentic AI development.
  • System thinking: Strong ability to design and evolve complex systems with a focus on scalability, maintainability, and performance.
  • Proficient in Python with strong coding fundamentals and architectural judgment; hands-on experience delivering complex systems. The candidate must have strong coding skills in Numpy, Panas, NLU, NLP and machine learning algorithms.
  • Deep understanding of LLMs and agent architectures, including:
    • Task decomposition & planning
    • Tool use / function calling patterns
    • Context and session management
    • Memory design
    • Execution loops and exception handling
  • Practical experience with LangChain and/or LangGraph (or equivalent orchestration frameworks).
  • Familiarity with mainstream AI coding and developer tools (examples: Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Copilot or equivalence).
  • Hands-on experience designing and implementing enterprise RAG, GraphRAG, or knowledge graph solutions for real application scenarios.
  • Proven track record designing, building, and operating large-scale, low-latency, highly available, resilient platforms and shared services (API gateway/service gateway experience strongly preferred)
  • Experience building secure-by-design platforms in regulated environments, with strong understanding of non-functional requirements (security, resilience, data protection, auditability)
  • Strong knowledge of AI capabilities and their applications in financial services, including working knowledge of Generative AI/LLM platform patterns (model access, prompt/tooling services, guardrails, evaluation/monitoring) and how to enabler safe consumption at scale.
  • Proven ability to build, lead, and develop high-performing global teams spanning AI SMEs and full stack engineers across multiple regions and time zones.
  • Strong stakeholder management skills, able to align business lines, infrastructure and control functions; clearly articulate AI capabilities and influence senior technology and business leaders.
  • Experience working in Agile delivery models with strong collaboration and execution discipline.
What additional skills will be good to have?

  • Experience with the following technologies (Hadoop, Spark, YARN, Kafka, Hive, HBase, MapReduce, RESTful services, Nosql database such as Mongo) would be an advantage.
  • Team player and experience working in global teams with members in different locations.
  • Aptitude to independently learn new technologies.
  • Strong interpersonal and presentation skills with good command of written and spoken English
  • Strong interpersonal skills, with the capacity to foster partnership among project participants and collaborate with them to ensure successful project delivery
